subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Real Estate as a Laundry Machine
description: A fast breakdown of Real Estate as a Laundry Machine for builders.

hook.text: Luxury condos in Miami and London are bought with cash through anonymous LLCs. Nobody asks where the money came from.

buildup.text: Real estate is the world's favorite laundering vehicle. It's high-value, appreciates, and accepts cash.

discovery.text: FinCEN found that over 30% of all-cash luxury real estate purchases in the US involved suspicious buyers.

twist.text: Until 2024, US real estate agents had no AML obligations. They could close deals without checking sources.

climax.text: New rules now require real estate to report beneficial ownership. The biggest loophole is finally closing.

punchline.text: Buy a condo in cash. No questions asked. Until now.

quiz.question: Why is real estate popular for money laundering?
options: High value, accepts cash, and historically lacked AML checks
It's the only asset that can't be traced
